facts.fact: POTRAZ implemented the Cyber and Data Protection Licencing regulations (S.I. 155 of 2024), setting licence fees of USD 50 to 2,500 for data controllers and certification for data protection officers.
facts.system: Cyber and Data Protection Licencing regulations (S.I. 155 of 2024)

ZWE.note: The licensing regulations are stated, but not the law, treaty, authority or ruling values.

facts.fact: Jacob Mutisi writes that there appears to have been limited or no consultation with affected groups before the Cyber and Data Protection Licencing regulations (S.I. 155 of 2024) were enacted.
facts.system: Cyber and Data Protection Licencing regulations (S.I. 155 of 2024)
